synthesis.body: Asserting set equality between a projection's output and the same module's own eligibility flag is tautological: when the flag is wrong, both sides move together and the test stays green. Mutation-test any guard you add — delete the branch and confirm a named test fails. If nothing fails, the test documents the implementation rather than constraining it. Pin invariants against an independent expectation (a literal set, a frozen fixture) rather than against another output of the code under test.

title: A test that moves with the code cannot catch the code being wrong
